title: When a Lot of Trees Fall in the Woods…
content:
Through deadfall and determination, Alex completed the grueling course in 6 days and 12 hours. Second Growth is a short film about the Oregon Timber Trail, seen through Alex Schultz’s 2026 race across the 700-mile route. Come along for a look at the challenges faced along the way, and a glimpse at what lies ahead for this triple-crown-level route.

The post When a Lot of Trees Fall in the Woods… appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
